name: CreateGoogleInstance
label: Create Google Sheets Service Instance
description: Creates and returns a SheetsService instance using Google service account credentials.

fields.name: RunDelay
fields.label: Run Delay (ms)
fields.description: Delay in milliseconds before creating the Google Sheets instance. Helps avoid rate-limiting issues.

fields.name: AccountType
fields.label: Account Type
fields.description: The type of the service account (typically 'service_account').

fields.name: ProjectId
fields.label: Project ID
fields.description: The project ID associated with the Google Cloud Platform service account.

fields.name: PrivateKeyId
fields.label: Private Key ID
fields.description: The private key ID from the Google service account JSON file.

fields.name: PrivateKey
fields.label: Private Key
fields.description: The private key from the Google service account JSON file. Must include escape characters (e.g., \n).

fields.name: ClientEmail
fields.label: Client Email
fields.description: The email address of the Google service account.

fields.name: ClientId
fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: The client ID of the Google service account.

fields.name: SheetsService
fields.label: Sheets Service
fields.description: The SheetsService instance for interacting with Google Sheets API.
